source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Retains the baker's pause and dough process, which give the extended metaphor its pacing.
Leaves the royal occasion and hand gesture open instead of inventing an anniversary or alliance ceremony.
Follows the pinned baker reading and preserves the abrupt pronoun shift in the oven image.
Retains the divine trap and the difficult final hearing clause with its communal reference.
Follows transmitted gathering rather than emending to cutting themselves; retains the inner/outer contrast.
Keeps the elliptical upward and defective bow, without forcing Most High into the consonants.
